parameters.name: ContainerItems
parameters.description: List of container names that need to be whitelisted.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason why you add the risk item to the whitelist.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The data source. Valid values:

*   **default**: host baseline
*   **agentless**: agentless baseline

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The operation that you want to perform on the risk item.Valid values:
*  **1**: adds the risk item to the whitelist
*  **2**: removes the risk item from the whitelist

parameters.name: UuidList
parameters.description:
The UUIDs of the servers.

> You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas ignore-check-items --uuid-list 55bf7984-9b3b-4e8d-be8e-f3e5b0b40000 --check-and-risk-type-list CheckId=52 RiskType=weak_password --type 1 --reason already_config_in_another_way --lang zh --source agentless --check-ids 1 --container-items Uuid=14eb2fb6-ab02-4869-a1e1-2cdb0f700000 ContainerNames=anythingllm,ChuanhuChat --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas IgnoreCheckItems --region cn-hangzhou --CheckAndRiskTypeList.1.CheckId 52 --ContainerItems.1.ContainerNames 'anythingllm,ChuanhuChat' --Type 1 --CheckAndRiskTypeList.1.RiskType weak_password --ContainerItems.1.Uuid '14eb2fb6-ab02-4869-a1e1-2cdb0f700000' --Lang zh --CheckIds.1 1 --UuidList.1 '55bf7984-9b3b-4e8d-be8e-f3e5b0b40000' --Reason already_config_in_another_way --Source agentless
